scope: Independent source and CPU signal review; no model forward, generation, optimizer, or training launch.
verdict: PASS as bounded offline mechanism demonstration; NOT a neutral bugfix or complete OpenRLHF baseline.
validated_claims: Both branches start from the identical raw pre-whitening veRL advantage; original normalized tensors are never passed into the adapter.
A single AST-extracted pinned OpenRLHF normalization executes after boundary suppression; float64 oracle includes its unusual treatment of original zero slots in variance.
All 2627 supplied boundary positions are suppressed in all four arms; rewards, reward ranking, raw baseline, sample groups and known B:210 exclusion remain unchanged.
All eight EOS-only responses have zero local derivative with respect to their synthetic log-prob after the adapter. This is not a model-weight backward or a trained-model accuracy result.

The 50404 P_VR content sign changes are specifically negative-to-zero, caused by restoring naturally zero raw advantages. None is positive-to-negative. Natural zero raw values had become negative under the existing batch whitening.
The adapter also removes P_VR negative EOS gradients that previously discouraged empty responses, not only P_PRM positive EOS gradients.
PRM scores and their influence on peer raw baselines are untouched; empty score quality remains unresolved.
necessary_reporting_limits: Same adapter for both arms is a fair within-new-protocol comparison, but not evidence the transplant is semantically neutral relative to existing P-VR/P-PRM.
Canonical reconstructed boundaries are reused and are not literal original generation-time OpenRLHF token boundaries.
OpenRLHF also changes return/baseline construction and normalization relative to veRL. Mask-only transplantation must not be labelled a complete official reproduction.
The selected empty-containing batches, KL=0, missing historical generated IDs, and synthetic ratio=1 loss derivative do not establish training stability or causal accuracy gains.

Independent read confirms adapter raises on all-zero surviving advantages before the official normalizer would divide by zero. This is a declared fail-closed runtime guard, not an official reward change.

recommendation.do_not_promote_as: bug-fixed veRL PURE or a drop-in neutral training baseline
recommendation.more_defensible_next_offline_control: Implement complete pinned OpenRLHF signal path for both P-VR and P-PRM with source-checked score scale, baseline, boundary mask and normalization; compare with its independent AST reference before any separately authorized training.
recommendation.do_not_claim: Complete OpenRLHF guarantees no empty or nonempty meaningless-output hacking.
